preconditions.description: The dimensions of the field must be within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line) == m for line in field)
preconditions.description: Each line of the field must have exactly m characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'#', '.'} for line in field for c in line)
preconditions.description: Each character in the field must be either '#' or '.'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if any(c == '.' for line in field) else True
postconditions.description: If there are any empty cells, output '-1'.
All characters in the output must be valid, including '#' and digits representing figures.

postconditions.expression: all(c == '#' or (c.isdigit() and any(c == str(i) for i in range(10))) for line in field for c in line)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output must be either '#' or a digit representing a figure.
